Five Family Members Found Dead in Raipur; Debt Cited as Possible Motive

In Raipur, five members of a family were discovered deceased. The incident appears to involve a man who allegedly killed his wife and children before taking his own life by hanging. Reports suggest the man was experiencing financial distress due to debt and loan repayments.
